items.t: Led union activists in 1996 in raising funds to place a 35 percent minimum wage increase on the California state ballot, and the measure passed (1996).
items.q: in 1996, following years of unsuccessful attempts to attract the support of California politicians, disgruntled union activists led by State Sen. Hilda Solis, now serving as President Obama’s secretary of labor, scraped together the funds to place a huge 35 percent minimum wage increase on the state ballot.
